summary.clearance_waiver: Waive the dues of {{flat}} for a transfer: {{reason}}

inbox.intro: Requests that need a second person. You never decide your own, or one that pays you; the policy in force says who may decide each.
inbox.emptyRequested: You have not asked for any approval
inbox.fixedIntro: Approvals billing and collections raise on their own screens (billing runs, exemptions, opening balances, payer changes, collection accounts, payment exceptions). Each keeps its own fixed maker-checker.
inbox.emptyFixed: No billing or collections approval is waiting

detail.subject: What is asked
detail.nobody: Nobody eligible can decide right now (for example, the only holder is named in the request).
detail.never: Never the person who asked, nor anyone named in the request. A delegate never acts for the person who asked.

why.conflict_of_interest: You are named in this request
why.not_an_approver: The policy does not name you for this
why.delegate_own_request: Delegated by the person who asked

whyBody.own_request: Someone other than you must decide it. This is checked by your sign-in, not your name.
whyBody.conflict_of_interest: It pays you, or it concerns your own flat. Another approver decides.
whyBody.already_decided: One person gives one approval. The rule needs another person.
whyBody.not_an_approver: Only the offices or roles in the rule (or their delegates) decide this.
whyBody.permission_missing: Your role does not include deciding approvals.
whyBody.delegate_own_request: A delegate never acts for the person who asked: that would be them approving their own request.

decide.title: Your decision
decide.rejectReason: Why you reject it (the requester sees this)
decide.note: Your decision is recorded with your name, the rule and the time. It cannot be changed afterwards.

policy.intro: Who approves what, by subject and amount. Versioned: a change is a new version, approved under the version in force, from a future date. No amount is fixed in the software.
policy.drafted: Draft created from the version in force
policy.selfTitle: A draft never governs its own approval
policy.selfBody: A new version is approved under the version in force, by someone other than its author. No version can make anyone an approver of their own requests.
policy.draftOf: Draft by {{name}} (only they can change it).
policy.subject: Subject
policy.effectiveFrom: In force from (YYYY-MM-DD, a future date)
policy.submitted: Sent for approval under the version in force

delegation.intro: While you are away, someone else can decide in your place: for the subjects you choose, between two dates, recorded and audited.
delegation.ruleTitle: What a delegate can never do
delegation.ruleBody: Decide their own request, or one you asked for, or one that pays them. One person gives one approval, even holding two seats.
delegation.audited: Every delegation, and every decision made under one, is audited.

committee.powersTitle: A title grants nothing by itself
committee.powersBody: An office holder acts only through their own staff sign-in and role, and approves only what the approval policy in force names their office for. Committee membership never opens residents' finances.
committee.signIn: Has a staff sign-in (acts through it)
committee.noSignIn: No sign-in: cannot approve in the app

duty.president: Chairs meetings; approves reopening a month and policy changes when named.
duty.general_secretary: Keeps minutes and resolutions; second signatory for large vouchers, transfers and waivers.
duty.treasurer: Approves vouchers, transfers and reversals within the policy; closes the month.

committee.noRole: Not linked to a staff role
committee.linkRole: Staff role this office works through
committee.noAuthority: The policy in force names this office for no approval.
committee.title: Title
committee.publish: Publish to residents (residents see only published resolutions)
committee.policyLine: Approval policy version {{version}}, in force from {{from}}.
committee.readOnly: You can see the committee; changing it is for the committee secretary.

events.officeLinked: linked an office to a role
events.policySubmitted: sent a policy version for approval

reminders.intro: Dues reminders by rule: when, on which channels, at most how often. Only the person liable for the bill is reminded, never someone who has paid or whose payment is being checked.
reminders.simulatedBody: No SMS or WhatsApp leaves the prototype. In-app reminders and the history are recorded as they would be.
reminders.quiet: Quiet hours {{from}}–{{to}}: SMS and WhatsApp wait until they end.
reminders.cap_one: At most {{count}} reminder a month for each payer.
reminders.cap_other: At most {{count}} reminders a month for each payer.
reminders.never: Never to a payer who has paid, whose proof is pending in any state (one needing information gets that request instead), or whose cheque waits to clear. No late-fee wording (late fees are off).
reminders.offset: Days from the due date (negative = before)
reminders.drafted: New version saved as a draft
reminders.counts: Sent {{sent}} · skipped {{skipped}} · waiting for quiet hours to end {{deferred}}

skip.no_consent: no consent or number for this channel

reminders.sendSubtitle: Who receives what, and why the others are skipped. Pressing send twice never sends twice.
reminders.clockHint: The prototype's date is frozen; pick a time of day to see quiet hours at work.
reminders.quietNowBody: In-app reminders go now; SMS and WhatsApp wait until the quiet hours end.
reminders.replayed: Already sent with this request: nothing was sent again.

print.runCount_one: The pack holds exactly the run's {{count}} posted invoice ({{period}}).
print.runCount_other: The pack holds exactly the run's {{count}} posted invoices ({{period}}).
print.payee: Pay by transfer to {{bank}}, {{title}}, IBAN {{iban}}, reference {{reference}}.
print.footer: Addressed only to the person liable. A notice never lists other residents.
print.more: And {{count}} more in the printed pack.

ownership.intro: A flat changes owner once its dues are clear, the transfer fee is paid and someone other than the requester approves. The clearance certificate then raises the payer change; earlier dues stay with whoever owed them.
ownership.newSubtitle: The outgoing owner is taken from the register. The new owner becomes liable from the date you give.
ownership.emptyBody: Start one when an owner sells or gives their flat.
ownership.name: Full name
ownership.effective: New owner from (first of a month not yet billed)
ownership.effectiveHint: YYYY-MM-DD. Like any payer change, it starts on the first day of an unbilled month.
ownership.title: Transfer of {{flat}}
ownership.subtitle: {{ref}} · {{from}} → {{to}} · from {{date}}
ownership.notYours: Someone else approves it. You can still check dues and invoice the fee.
ownership.clear: Nothing is owed on this flat.
ownership.owed: {{amount}} is still owed on this flat:
ownership.pending: {{amount}} in proofs or cheques is still being checked (not counted as paid).
ownership.historic: Each line stays with whoever was liable for it; the transfer erases no earlier liability.
ownership.noRate: No transfer fee is set for this date.
ownership.takePayment: Take the payment at the office
ownership.waiverBody: If the dues will not be paid before the transfer, two committee officers who are not party to the sale may approve waiving them.
ownership.waiverReason: Why the dues should be waived
ownership.waitDues: Waiting: the dues must be clear (or waived) and the fee paid.
ownership.payerChange: Payer change from {{date}} to {{name}} raised in the payer-change queue, for approval there.
ownership.certificateText: Flat {{flat}} (account {{account}}): the association confirms that on {{date}} no dues were outstanding against the owner {{owner}}, for the transfer to {{incoming}}.
ownership.certificateWaived: Dues of {{amount}} were waived by an approved waiver.
